rows.note: This is the all-purpose adjective for something understood by comparison or in relation to something else.

example.english: Relative to the market price, this price is much cheaper.
example.traditional: 相對市價嚟講，呢個價錢平好多。
example.jyutping: soeng1 deoi3 si5 gaa3 lai4 gong2 ni1 go3 gaa3 cin2 peng4 hou2 do1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for a relative connected by blood, marriage, or adoption.

example.english: We visit a relative during Chinese New Year.
example.jyutping: gwo3 nin4 ngo5 dei6 wui5 heoi3 taam3 can1 cik1

rows.note: Use this when the relative is being treated as an immediate family or household member rather than as an extended relation.

example.english: When a relative is ill, I always look after them.
example.traditional: 家人病咗，我一定會照顧佢。
example.jyutping: gaa1 jan4 beng6 zo2 ngo5 jat1 ding6 wui5 ziu3 gu3 keoi5
